metadata.description: Marketplace for Claude skills that run a household: recurring domestic loops that plan, execute, and remember. Meals today; the family is built to grow.

plugins.name: gruntwork-meals
plugins.description: Run a household meal plan as a repeating loop: plan the covered days, acquire the food, cook the meals, and record what actually happened so next week's plan is smarter than this week's. Generic by construction — every household detail lives in that household's own state store.
